subject: Physics
q: At a particular wavelength, a medium has relative permittivity 3 and relative permeability 4/3. What is its critical angle at an interface with vacuum?
hint: First calculate the refractive index from the relative permittivity and permeability.
solution: The refractive index is $n=\sqrt{\varepsilon_r\mu_r}=\sqrt{3\times4/3}=2$. For the medium-to-vacuum critical angle, $\sin i_c=1/n=1/2$, hence $i_c=30°$.
